text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Let's see... That should do it.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm all set.
But... what did you mean by asking me to start a stream?
choice_data_list: You'll see soon. By the way, just to check...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
?
What is it?
choice_data_list: Do you remember your fan community member count?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Well... of course I do.
As of today, 9,927 members.
choice_data_list: Yep, perfect. Let's get started, then.

text_block_list.text:
Confirming that preparations are complete,
I send the prearranged signal on my smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, amazing. People are already joining.
Ah, mic check, mic check. How is it? Can you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —"Loud and clear!" ...Aha, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...All right.
Let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
How's everyone doing~?
Love me♡ Love you♡ It's Loves Only You~♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I didn't give any notice, so it's a totally impromptu stream, but—
...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: What is this...? This can't be the viewer count, right...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: There's no way concurrent viewers could—
choice_data_list: It's real. Everyone gathered here for you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
choice_data_list: And—

text_block_list.text: I pull out my phone and tap the screen right in front of her eyes.
choice_data_list: Count me in, and that makes 9,927.
Count me in, and that makes 9,927.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—... No way. You were a community member, too?
So... you knew everything that happened recently, and prepared this...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—... No way. You were a community member, too?
So... you knew everything that happened recently, and prepared this...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
But how did you manage to get every single person together?
Everyone's schedules and daily lives are so different...
choice_data_list: Nothing could possibly take higher priority than this.

text_block_list.text:
Of course everyone had their own plans. Yet even if only for this single moment,
they all made a pledge to come together.

So she would never feel alone. To show her that we are all united.
Showing her a thick booklet that crystallized those feelings, I speak.
choice_data_list: With the love of 9,927 people, we'll send you out into the world.
With the love of 9,927 people, we'll send you out into the world.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
choice_data_list: Once you start running, so many new horizons will open up.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —"And there will surely be more things you'll want to do"...
choice_data_list: When that time comes, so that you can walk whatever path you choose—
When that time comes, so that you can walk whatever path you choose—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —"Though we cannot pull you by the hand"...
choice_data_list: We can certainly light the path ahead for you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A simulation of my aptitudes based on my running... and a training regimen.
Diet, recovery... Down to such detail...
choice_data_list: Take a look at the second half, too.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The second half...? 
—Ah...
choice_data_list: That part was put together by everyone in the community.

text_block_list.text:
Fan interaction activities centered around her streams.
While keeping the core intact, it was a plan to help widen that circle even further.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Thank you... Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I never even considered it. A path where I couldn't walk together with all of you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm so... so glad I believed.
I received everyone's love loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'll turn this love... into glorious victories, and give it right back to everyone!
choice_data_list: We'll turn that joy into cheers and give it right back to you.
We'll turn that joy into cheers and give it right back to you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Let's make our love grow bigger and bigger just like that.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
When it reaches further and further out...
that'll be the greatest love of all, won't it?
choice_data_list: By then, it won't just be 9,927—it'll probably be a million.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No. Even if it reaches that many, the number where it all began won't ever change.
Because to me... it's a precious number I'll never forget for the rest of my life♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Let's form our contract.
Right here, in front of everyone.
choice_data_list: —Yeah!
—Yeah!

text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Sparring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...!
I can't... keep up—!

text_block_list.name: Sparring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I heard she only just got a Trainer the other day...!
And yet I, who dedicate everything to training, can't even...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Taking a stoic approach makes you stronger... That might
be the correct answer for the majority. But it's not for me.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(The people who receive my "love" and return their "love" to me...
It's precisely because I feel their presence by my side—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: How was that, Trainer-kun♪
choice_data_list: Spot on! ...Leaving aside the "-kun" honorific.
Spot on! ...Leaving aside the "-chan" honorific.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: How does that look, Trainer-chan? ♪
choice_data_list: Spot on! ...Though I'm not sure about the "-kun."
Spot on! ...Though I'm not sure about the "-chan."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Aw, come on, what's wrong with it?
Besides, don't you think this way feels... more full of love?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Loves Only You.
You've grown even stronger than when I first tried to scout you.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I stand corrected. An Umamusume who draws strength from running for others truly does exist.
...And you've embodied that perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe ♡
Except I didn't do it alone—it was all of *us* who made it happen ♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Having the love of so many people pushing me forward...
As long as I'm not alone, there's no limit to how strong I can become! ♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: After all—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Love me ♡ Love you ♡
Because I'm Loves Only You! ♡
